newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PureFoods forms jv to operate Burger King.
newsitem.headline: PureFoods forms jv to operate Burger King.

text.p: PureFoods Corp had formed a joint venture with two other food companies to take on the exclusive franchise of Burger King restaurants in the Philippines, Burger King Corp said on Tuesday.
In a statement, Burger King said it had awarded the franchise to PhilKing Restaurants Development Corp which will build more than 60 restaurants over the next five years.
PhilKing is composed of PureFoods Corp, a subsidiary of Ayala Corp, ELRO Commercial and Industrial Corp of the Philippines, and RY LLC of the United States.
RY LLC is a major franchisee of Burger King in the United States and Israel.
Burger King is a subsidiary of Grand Metropolitan plc, one of the world's leading branded food and drink companies with brands such as Haagen-Dazs, Smirnoff and Baileys.
